categories.name: Core Runtime
categories.evidence: Startup, shutdown, health, and full regression coverage remain broad.
categories.next_action: Keep startup checks bounded.

categories.name: CLI Experience
categories.evidence: Quiet CLI, free-form chat routing, bounded commands, and malformed-quote handling are stable.
categories.next_action: Add usability fixes only from observed defects.

categories.name: Local AI
categories.evidence: Real Ollama text chat and free-form routing are manually verified through Provider Router.
categories.next_action: Keep truthful unavailable handling when the PC or Ollama is offline.

categories.name: Conversation Intelligence
categories.evidence: Bounded multi-turn state, topics, entities, follow-up intent, references, clarification, repair, modes, confidence, and summaries are integrated with normal chat.
categories.next_action: Improve language understanding from observed ambiguity without hidden persistence.

categories.name: Cloud Provider Foundation
categories.evidence: Adapters, policy, normalization, commands, and mocked tests exist.
categories.next_action: Add opt-in live smoke checks when authorized.

categories.name: Tools
categories.evidence: Governed calculator/text tools execute and the metadata-only Skill Registry declares permissions, side effects, approval, and future integrations; external breadth remains limited.
categories.next_action: Add executable skills only through separately verified owning milestones.

categories.name: Planning
categories.evidence: Advisory plans and validation exist without automatic execution.
categories.next_action: Improve evidence and review UX.

categories.name: Multi-Agent System
categories.evidence: Typed protocols, a validated registry, truthful specialist metadata, bounded diagnostics, and Prime Agent plan-only delegation are tested without side effects.
categories.next_action: Expand executable specialists only with capability evidence and scoped approvals.

categories.name: Model Router
categories.evidence: Provider-neutral model metadata, local-only deterministic routing, unavailable fallbacks, policy diagnostics, and safe hardware hints are tested; routing does not execute models.
categories.next_action: Integrate additional local providers only through explicit tested adapters.

categories.name: Skill Registry
categories.evidence: Native and future skill manifests declare permissions, risk, side effects, approval, locality, and availability; external plugins and MCP remain disabled.
categories.next_action: Keep external plugins disabled until trust, installation, and execution policies are separately implemented.

categories.name: Voice Output
categories.evidence: Windows SAPI long replies and non-blocking stop, resume, cancel, interrupt, repeat, and replay controls are manually verified without persistent audio.
categories.next_action: Preserve bounded interruption and safe speech filtering.

categories.name: Voice Input
categories.evidence: Local Vosk microphone input with an Indian-English model and explicit voice listen send handoff are manually verified.
categories.next_action: Keep wake word, continuous conversation, and multilingual switching separate and privacy-reviewed.

categories.name: Memory
categories.evidence: Local memory, explicit controls, bounded retrieval, safe summaries, and non-destructive startup retention/duplicate compaction are tested.
categories.next_action: Review lifecycle outcomes from real use without automatic deletion.

categories.name: Web Interface
categories.evidence: Loopback UI works but may feel laggy and is not primary.
categories.next_action: Use CLI until a dedicated stabilization milestone.

categories.name: Vision
categories.evidence: Local Ollama LLaVA image analysis and image Q&A are manually verified through governed routing with metadata-only audit.
categories.next_action: Keep live camera/video, identity inference, and high-stakes certainty outside this scope.

categories.name: Deployment / Online Foundation
categories.evidence: Canonical jarvis-os production remains Ready and status-only.
categories.next_action: Retain jarvis-os and leave jarvis-os-6oy2 unused.

categories.name: Online Sync
categories.evidence: Bounded atomic local queue, allowlisted summaries, conflict/audit retention, and manual CLI work exist; no encrypted remote backend exists.
categories.next_action: Design and verify an authenticated encrypted remote adapter before enabling transfer.

categories.name: Web Automation
categories.evidence: Read-only public page inspection and status work with DNS and redirect SSRF checks, bounded text extraction, CLI permissions, and redacted audit; no interactive browser control exists.
categories.next_action: Keep sensitive actions blocked until a separate approval-gated interaction milestone.

categories.name: Mobile Automation
categories.evidence: Planning-only manager, policy gates, CLI commands, adapters, bounded redacted audit, and tests exist; no phone is accessed.
categories.next_action: Add a separately approved real adapter and enrollment model without weakening current blocks.

categories.name: Study and Research Workflows
categories.evidence: Conversation, retrieval, research, goals, planning, and read-only web foundations exist; no dedicated study workflow composes them.
categories.next_action: Keep this partial until a dedicated future study workflow milestone is implemented.

categories.name: Advanced Builder Workflows
categories.evidence: Planning, tools, multi-agent review, providers, tests, and Git practices exist independently; Builder Mode is not formalized.
categories.next_action: Formalize the governed workflow in a future dedicated milestone.

categories.name: Raspberry Pi and Hardware
categories.evidence: General coding guidance is available, but no device profiles, deployment checks, or physical-action boundary exists.
categories.next_action: Keep hardware work deferred to a future dedicated milestone.

categories.name: Creative Media Workflows
categories.evidence: Governed image-generation and video-editing workflow foundations exist with prompt validation, safety policy, provider abstraction, dry-run planning, bounded metadata, and truthful unavailable-provider handling. Real local generation and real local editing still require configured providers.
categories.next_action: Add real local media providers only with approved integrations.

categories.name: Communication Assistance
categories.evidence: Future communication agent and skill metadata is visible, but no call, contact, calendar, messaging, or communication connector is integrated.
categories.next_action: Define consent and connector boundaries in a future communication milestone.

categories.name: Personal Workspace
categories.evidence: CLI access, project tracking, and Phase 3 routing metadata compose capabilities without replacing their authoritative subsystems; a complete multi-tool workspace remains future work.
categories.next_action: Harden the current local-first experience without duplicating authorities.

categories.name: Security/Permissions
categories.evidence: Permission, approval, locality, tool, provider, and UI boundaries are tested.
categories.next_action: Threat-review every external integration.

categories.name: Testing/Release Readiness
categories.evidence: Phase 3 focused checks and the 1661-test full suite pass with three environment-dependent skips.
categories.next_action: Keep release evidence and status docs current.
